title: Month view events now look like Apple Calendar
summary: Timed events in the Calendar's month view now show as a colored bar with the event title when there's room, instead of always being a plain dot.
All-day events get their own stack of thin colored lines at the top of the day cell, separate from timed events, so a multi-day event doesn't crowd out everything else.

Once a day has more events than comfortably fit, the extras degrade to small dots (with a '+N' count) the same way they always did -- and on a narrow cell or small screen, bars shrink straight to just their color instead of unreadable truncated text.
